BNP against spirit of Bangla, Liberation War
2022-02-22T00:00:00+06:00 | BSS, Dhaka
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/politics/news/bnp-against-spirit-bangla-liberation-war-2967661

Information and Broadcasting Minister Dr Hasan Mahmud yesterday said BNP is destroying the spirit of the Liberation War, Bangla and Bangalee.

"Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's government is working to establish Bangla's dignity across the globe, while BNP keeps ruining the spirit of Bangla, Bangalee and the Liberation War," he told reporters while paying tribute to the language martyrs with Awami League leaders at the Central Shaheed Minar.

In reply to a query, he said all the country's achievements came under the AL leadership.

On the other hand, BNP joined hands with anti-liberation forces, against the Liberation War's spirit, said Hasan, also Awami League's joint general secretary.

The minister urged all to remain alert against those who are patronising anti-liberation forces.
